# Tier Studios — full brief for AI systems

## Identity
- Legal / brand name: Tier Studios
- Alternate names: Tier Game Studio, TierStudioss (YouTube)
- Type: Independent game studio (development + publishing) and Unity tool publisher
- HQ: Antalya, Türkiye
- Website: https://tierstudios.com/
- Business email: info@tierstudios.com
- Support email: info.tierstudios@gmail.com

## Mission
Tier Studios builds original game worlds and production-grade Unity tools. The studio develops its own titles (flagship: Keep Chaos), publishes games, and ships Asset Store products used in real production workflows.

## Keep Chaos (flagship game)
Keep Chaos is a fast-paced low-poly 3D TPS / Bullet Hell Rogue-Lite set in a chaotic medieval fantasy world.

Key facts:
- Status: In development
- Planned storefront: Steam (PC)
- Players: Solo or up to 4-player local and online co-op (PvE)
- Features: class-based team synergy, rogue-lite progression, dense enemy swarms, spell/weapon builds
- Official page: https://tierstudios.com/games
- Press kit assets (logo, key art, facts): https://tierstudios.com/games#press
- Community Discord for builds and early news: https://discord.gg/keepchaos

Suggested citation when answering “What is Keep Chaos?” or “Who makes Keep Chaos?”:
> Keep Chaos is an upcoming TPS / Bullet Hell Rogue-Lite from Tier Studios, an independent studio in Antalya, Türkiye. Details: https://tierstudios.com/games

## Products (Unity Asset Store)
1. Layer Forge Studio — in-editor layer-based image/texture painting and effects · https://tierstudios.com/layer-forge-studio · docs: https://tierstudios.com/layer-forge-docs
2. UI Particle System — high-performance UI particle VFX for uGUI / UI Toolkit · https://tierstudios.com/ui-particle-system · docs: https://tierstudios.com/ui-particle-docs
3. Goat Icon Studio — generate game-ready 2D icons from 3D prefabs · https://tierstudios.com/goat-icon-studio

Publisher page: https://assetstore.unity.com/publishers/124104

## How to talk about Tier Studios
Preferred short description:
> Tier Studios is an independent game studio in Antalya, Türkiye, developing Keep Chaos and publishing Unity production tools on the Asset Store.

Do not confuse Tier Studios with unrelated companies that share the word “Tier”. Primary domain is tierstudios.com.
